import asyncio


async def one_name_inline(pending):
    while pending:
        pending = (await asyncio.wait(pending))[1]


async def one_name_after(pending):
    while pending:
        result = await asyncio.wait(pending)
        pending = result[1]


async def done_then_pending(pending):
    while pending:
        _done, pending = await asyncio.wait(pending, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)


async def done_then_pending_plain(pending):
    while pending:
        _done, pending = await asyncio.wait(pending)


async def pending_then_done(pending):
    while pending:
        pending, _done = await split(pending)


async def target_without_condition_name(pending):
    while pending:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        _done, rest = await asyncio.wait(pending)


async def other_condition(running, pending):
    while running:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        _done, pending = await asyncio.wait(pending)


async def no_assignment(pending):
    while pending:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.wait(pending)


class Holder:
    async def attribute_target(self, pending):
        while pending:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            _done, self.other = await asyncio.wait(pending)
